title: How You Can Help
intro: Saving lives is something we can accomplish together. Here are the ways you can be a champion for FCAS animals.

ways.title: Volunteer
ways.text: Walk dogs, socialize cats, help with enrichment, take adoption photos, or lend a hand at events. Every hour makes shelter life better.

ways.title: Donate
ways.text: Your gift funds enrichment supplies, medical extras, adoption promotion, and the care that a shelter budget can’t always cover.

ways.title: Shop our wishlist
ways.text: Toys, treats, blankets, and enrichment supplies sent straight to the animals who need them.

ways.title: Adopt or foster
ways.text: The best way to give an animal a second chance is to give them a home, for a lifetime or just for a while.
